# demo-drifty v1

`pinned` authorizes this one. After `./drift.sh` the reference names bytes that no longer exist, so
this skill is withheld from `pinned` — by name, with the repair named — and `pinned` keeps running
without it. The fixture exists to check that the update costs this skill and nothing else.
